notes: Portentous Tanggu (mb3iqw3kc6, GeneratedMacroCode.php enterAbilities["mb3iqw3kc6:0"]): "[Guo Jia Bonus] On Enter: Put a quest counter on your champion. Break/restore verified: commenting out AddQuestCounters() makes the fixture fail and restoring it passes again. Note: materializing this card required paying a 3-reserve cost via activationCostModifierAbilities["mb3iqw3kc6:0"], which unconditionally forces the activation cost to 3 for ANY activation of this CardID (not narrowly scoped to its separate printed '(3), Banish CARDNAME: Draw a card into your memory' activated ability) -- not flagged as a bug here since it didn't block proving the On Enter clause, but worth a second look if Portentous Tanggu's real deckbuilding cost ever looks wrong.
